tool.name: ASan/LSan + Valgrind combined
tool.command_template: ASan/LSan run + Valgrind Memcheck run; leak if either reports

settings.strict_policy: non-ok records count wrong; valid-only metrics exclude them
settings.dynamic_clean_policy: operational view counts clean as no-leak; conservative view abstains because coverage was not measured

pending.note: This tool reproduces the historical 5-tool view only; round-2 LLM/hybrid/repair are in final_summary.json and LEADERBOARD.md.

juliet_llm.reason: MiMo Xiaomi fallback and hybrid runs are in the final summary; DeepSeek B4 remains unavailable (401/402).

juliet_hybrid.reason: B6/B7 are done in the final summary; B8 cascade remains planned.

tier_a_static_feasibility.reason: 160 SecVulEval functions are fragments; no Tier A static F1 is reported

limitations: Juliet is synthetic, single-CWE and template-based; these numbers do not extrapolate to real projects.
Static compile errors are retained as non-ok; they are not scored as zero, and valid-only coverage is reported.
The dynamic run has no line/branch coverage instrumentation; a clean result is not a verified true negative.
The runtime-supported 178/128 population was defined with an LSan preflight, so ASan scores on that subset are largely circular; Valgrind and static are the informative comparisons.
Only 29 test families; cluster bootstrap is descriptive, not a high-power inference.
This historical view excludes round-2 LLM/hybrid/repair; see LEADERBOARD.md and final_summary.json for those runs.
